```{=html}
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; table-layout:fixed; font-size:13px; line-height:1.35; }
  #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap td { border:1px solid var(--line); padding:3px 6px; vertical-align:top; text-align:left; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
  #tp-wrap thead th { background:var(--head); font-weight:bold; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap th.c, #tp-wrap td.c { text-align:center; }
  #tp-wrap tr.sec td { background:var(--sect); font-weight:bold; padding:2px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap tr.lab td { padding:2px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap td.ind { padding-left:16px; }
  #tp-wrap td.muted { color:#666; font-style:italic; }
  #tp-wrap td.accent { color:#1f5f8b; }
  #tp-wrap td.small { font-size:12px; color:#222; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg { padding:3px; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); border-radius:3px; background:var(--box);
    text-align:center; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; padding:6px 2px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:#6a7fa3; font-size:12px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-foot { font-size:12.5px; margin:.6rem 0 0; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-foot.lic { font-size:11.5px; color:#333; }
  .tp-actions { display:flex; gap:.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1rem 0 1.4rem; }
  .tp-actions button { font:600 15px Arial,sans-serif; padding:.55rem 1.1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid #2a5aa7; background:#2a5aa7; color:#fff; }
  .tp-actions button.alt { background:#fff; color:#2a5aa7; }
  .tp-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3b800; outline-offset:2px; }
  .tp-note { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; color:#444; margin:0; flex-basis:100%; }

  @media print {
    @page { size:A4 landscape; margin:10mm; }
    body * { visibility:hidden; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap * { visibility:visible; }
    #tp-wrap { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; max-width:none; }
    .tp-actions { display:none !important; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:block; }
    #tp-wrap table { font-size:9.5px; }
    #tp-wrap td.small { font-size:9px; }
    #tp-wrap tr { break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap thead { display:table-header-group; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:15px; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-sub { font-size:10px; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-foot { font-size:9px; } #tp-wrap .tp-foot.lic { font-size:8px; }
    #tp-wrap td.pg input { background:none; border:0; }
    #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:transparent; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:none; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap tr.sec td { -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact; }

     "t": "The responses in the free-text comments were analyzed by two independent reviewers [SPECIFY].",
     "cls": "small"
    }
   ]
  },
  {
   "key": "p38",
   "label": "Location, item 38",
   "cells": [
    null,
    null,
    {
     "t": "38"
    },
    {
     "t": "Reflection on potential limitations (e.g., number of experts, response bias)"
    },
    {
     "t": "The results are to be viewed critically with regard to the composition of the panel because [REASONS].",
     "cls": "small"
    }
   ]
  }
 ],
 "foot": [
  {
   "t": "¹ “Experts” are the participants; these can be people from academia, practice, or representatives of lived experience (e.g., patients, family members)."
  },
  {
   "t": "² The term “questionnaire” stands for the survey instrument regardless of whether quantitative or qualitative items are integrated or weighted."
  },
  {
   "t": "Citation: Niederberger M, Schifano J, Deckert S, Hirt J, Homberg A, Köberich S, Kuhn R, Rommel A, Sonnberger M & the DEWISS network. Delphi studies in social and health sciences—Recommendations for an interdisciplinary standardized reporting (DELPHISTAR). Results of a Delphi study. PLoS ONE. 2024;19(8):e0304651. [[https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0304651|https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0304651]]. More information: [[OSF|https://osf.io/gc4jk]] and [[DEWISS|https://delphi.ph-gmuend.de/]]."
  }
 ]
};

  const esc = s => String(s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  const nl2br = s => esc(s).replace(/\n/g, "<br>");
  // Build rich text with DOM calls (no literal href/src attributes in the script source)
  const addRich = (el, text) => {
    const lead = text.match(/^[*†]/);
    if (lead) { const s = document.createElement("sup"); s.textContent = lead[0]; el.appendChild(s); text = text.slice(1); }
    const re = /\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g; let last = 0, m;
    while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
      if (m.index > last) el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(last, m.index)));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.setAttribute("href", m[2]); a.setAttribute("target", "_blank"); a.setAttribute("rel", "noopener");
      a.textContent = m[1]; el.appendChild(a);
      last = re.lastIndex;
    }
    if (last < text.length) el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(last)));
  };
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const COLS = CFG.cols, NC = COLS.length, TOTAL = COLS.reduce((a, c) => a + c.w, 0);
  const INPUT = COLS.find(c => c.input);
  const ROWS = CFG.rows;

  // ---- static parts ----
  if (CFG.logoLeft) {
    const im = document.createElement("img");
    im.setAttribute("src", CFG.logoLeft); im.setAttribute("alt", ""); im.id = "tp-logo";
    $("tp-left").appendChild(im);
  }
  $("tp-ttl").innerHTML = esc(CFG.title) + (CFG.star ? "<sup>*</sup>" : "");
  if (CFG.subtitle) $("tp-sub").textContent = CFG.subtitle; else $("tp-sub").remove();
  $("tp-note").textContent = CFG.note;
  CFG.foot.forEach(f => {
    const p = document.createElement("p");
    p.className = "tp-foot" + (f.lic ? " lic" : "");
    addRich(p, f.t);
    $("tp-foots").appendChild(p);
  });

  // ---- table ----
  const table = $("tp-table");
  table.querySelector("colgroup").innerHTML = COLS.map(c => `<col style="width:${(c.w / TOTAL * 100).toFixed(2)}%">`).join("");
  table.querySelector("thead").innerHTML = "<tr>" + COLS.map(c =>
    `<th class="${c.center ? "c" : ""}">${esc(c.h)}${c.hint ? `<span class="tp-hint">${esc(c.hint)}</span>` : ""}</th>`).join("") + "</tr>";

  table.querySelector("tbody").innerHTML = ROWS.map(r => {
    if (r.sec !== undefined) return `<tr class="sec"><td colspan="${NC}">${esc(r.sec)}</td></tr>`;
    if (r.lab !== undefined) return `<tr class="lab"><td colspan="${NC}">${esc(r.lab)}</td></tr>`;
    let k = 0;
    return "<tr>" + COLS.map(c => {
      if (c.input) return `<td class="pg"><input type="text" data-key="${r.key}" placeholder="${esc(c.ph || "page no.")}" aria-label="${esc(r.label)}"></td>`;
      const x = r.cells[k++];
      if (!x) return "";
      const cls = [c.center ? "c" : "", x.ind ? "ind" : "", x.muted ? "muted" : "", c.cls || "", x.cls || ""].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
      return `<td${cls ? ` class="${cls}"` : ""}${x.rs ? ` rowspan="${x.rs}"` : ""}>${nl2br(x.t)}</td>`;
    }).join("") + "</tr>";
  }).join("");

  // ---- persistence (localStorage, this browser only) ----
  const fields = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input")];
  const load = () => { try { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CFG.store) || "{}");
    fields().forEach(i => { if (d[i.dataset.key]) i.value = d[i.dataset.key]; }); } catch (e) {} };
  const save = () => { try { const d = {}; fields().forEach(i => { if (i.value) d[i.dataset.key] = i.value; });
    localStorage.setItem(CFG.store, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {} };
  load();
  $("tp-wrap").addEventListener("input", save);

  // Save as PDF via the browser print dialog (print CSS shows only the checklist)
  $("tp-pdf").onclick = () => {
    const old = document.title;
    document.title = CFG.docName;
    window.print();
    document.title = old;
  };

  $("tp-reset").onclick = () => {
    if (confirm("Clear all entries and the manuscript title?")) { fields().forEach(i => i.value = ""); save(); }
  };

  // ---- Word (.docx) export -------------------------------------------------
  // <BUILD>
  function buildDocx(D, CFG, vals, logo, eqLogo) {
    const F = "Arial", SZ = 17, W = CFG.cols.map(c => c.w), TOTAL = W.reduce((a, b) => a + b), NC = W.length;
    const ln = { style: D.BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "000000" };
    const run = (text, o = {}) => new D.TextRun({ text, font: F, size: o.size || SZ, bold: o.bold, italics: o.it, color: o.color, superScript: o.sup });
    const runs = (text, o = {}) => {
      const out = [], re = /\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g; let last = 0, m;
      while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        if (m.index > last) out.push(run(text.slice(last, m.index), o));
        out.push(new D.ExternalHyperlink({ link: m[2], children: [new D.TextRun({ text: m[1], font: F, size: o.size || SZ, color: "0563C1", underline: {} })] }));
        last = re.lastIndex;
      }
      if (last < text.length) out.push(run(text.slice(last), o));
      return out;
    };
    const lines = (text, o) => text.split("\n").flatMap((l, i) => i ? [new D.TextRun({ break: 1 }), ...runs(l, o)] : runs(l, o));
    const cell = (i, text, o = {}) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: o.span ? TOTAL : W[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnSpan: o.span ? NC : undefined, rowSpan: o.rowSpan,
      verticalAlign: o.mid ? D.VerticalAlign.CENTER : D.VerticalAlign.TOP,
      shading: o.fill ? { type: D.ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 40, bottom: 40, left: o.indent || 90, right: 90 }, borders: { top: ln, bottom: ln, left: ln, right: ln },
      children: [new D.Paragraph({ keepNext: o.keepNext, alignment: o.center ? D.AlignmentType.CENTER : D.AlignmentType.LEFT, children: lines(text, o) })]
    });
    const hd = { fill: "BFBFBF", bold: true, mid: true };
    const head = new D.TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: CFG.cols.map((c, i) => cell(i, c.h, { ...hd, center: c.center })) });
    const body = CFG.rows.map(r => {
      if (r.sec !== undefined) return new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r.sec, { span: true, fill: "B4C6E7", bold: true, keepNext: true })] });
      if (r.lab !== undefined) return new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r.lab, { span: true, keepNext: true })] });
      let k = 0;
      const kids = [];
      CFG.cols.forEach((c, i) => {
        if (c.input) { kids.push(cell(i, vals[r.key] || "", { center: true, mid: true })); return; }
        const x = r.cells[k++];
        if (!x) return;
        kids.push(cell(i, x.t, { rowSpan: x.rs, indent: x.ind ? 260 : 90, center: c.center, it: x.muted, color: x.muted ? "666666" : (c.cls === "accent" ? "1F5F8B" : undefined) }));
      });
      return new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: kids });
    });
    const para = (children, o = {}) => new D.Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 80 }, ...o, children });
    const footer = new D.Footer({ children: [new D.Paragraph({ alignment: D.AlignmentType.CENTER,
      children: [new D.TextRun({ children: ["Page ", D.PageNumber.CURRENT, " of ", D.PageNumber.TOTAL_PAGES], font: F, size: 18 })] })] });
    const none = { style: D.BorderStyle.NONE, size: 0, color: "FFFFFF" };
    const noBorders = { top: none, bottom: none, left: none, right: none };
    const HW = [TOTAL - 4300, 4300];
    const hcell = (i, children) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: HW[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, borders: noBorders,
      verticalAlign: D.VerticalAlign.CENTER, margins: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 }, children });
    const left = logo ? [para([new D.ImageRun({ data: logo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 180, height: 64 } })], { spacing: { after: 0 } })] : [para([], { spacing: { after: 0 } })];
    const right = eqLogo
      ? [para([new D.ImageRun({ data: eqLogo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 140, height: Math.round(140 * 90 / 310) } })], { alignment: D.AlignmentType.RIGHT, spacing: { after: 0 } })]
      : [para([], { alignment: D.AlignmentType.RIGHT, spacing: { after: 0 } })];
    const top = [];
    top.push(new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: HW, borders: { ...noBorders, insideHorizontal: none, insideVertical: none },
      rows: [new D.TableRow({ children: [hcell(0, left), hcell(1, right)] })] }));
    top.push(para([], { spacing: { after: 60 } }));
    top.push(para([run(CFG.title, { bold: true, size: 24 }), ...(CFG.star ? [run("*", { bold: true, size: 24, sup: true })] : [])], { spacing: { after: 100 } }));
    if (CFG.subtitle) top.push(para([run(CFG.subtitle, { size: 18 })], { spacing: { after: 100 } }));
    top.push(para([run("Manuscript title: ", { bold: true, size: 20 }), run(vals.title || "", { size: 20 })], { spacing: { after: 120 } }));
    return new D.Document({
      title: CFG.docName, creator: CFG.docName,
      sections: [{
        footers: { default: footer },
        properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838, orientation: D.PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE }, margin: { top: 720, bottom: 800, left: 720, right: 720 } } },
        children: [...top, new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: W, rows: [head, ...body] }),
          ...CFG.foot.map((f, i) => para(runs(f.t, { size: f.lic ? 14 : 16 }), { spacing: { before: i ? 60 : 140 } }))]
      }]
    });
  }
  // </BUILD>

  const loadDocx = () => window.docx ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const el = document.createElement("script");
    el.src = new URL("docx.min.js", document.baseURI).href;
    el.onload = res; el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Could not load docx.min.js"));
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  });

  $("tp-doc").onclick = async () => {
    const btn = $("tp-doc"), label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing…";
    try {
      await loadDocx();
      let logo = null;
      if (CFG.logoLeft) { try { logo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL(CFG.logoLeft, document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {} }
      let eqLogo = null;
      try { eqLogo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/equator_logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      const vals = {}; fields().forEach(i => vals[i.dataset.key] = i.value);
      const blob = await window.docx.Packer.toBlob(buildDocx(window.docx, CFG, vals, logo, eqLogo));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }));
      a.download = CFG.fileName + ".docx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Sorry, the Word file could not be created. " + e.message);
    } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
  };
})();
</script>
```
